messages:
Tara: Quick ask — before next week's deploy can we run a focused docs smoke pass? I ran a quick link-check and hit ~12 failures concentrated in /runtime and /getting-started.

docs-bot: automated-linkcheck: 12 failures found in docs paths: /runtime/examples, /getting-started/cli, /sdk/python. Report: https://internal/reports/linkcheck/8005554321 (generated)

Mike: I can own /runtime/examples. do you have a curated list or should I just run the full checker?

Tara: Curated is better — I made a smoke-list in the repo with highest-traffic pages and failing anchors.
Link: https://git.redwood/docs/smoke-lists/8005554321-smoke-list.md

Olivia: I’ll take onboarding + CLI snippets. saw one curl example that breaks on staging (bad header). I’ll update the snippet and add a small CI test.

Chris: Heads up — a couple of the failures are image 403s from the CDN shortlink. Those need a rehost + tiny PR. tagging @Jordan for quick PRs?

Jordan: Yep I can open the rehost PRs for the images and fix alt text where missing. Will batch into one tiny PR per directory.

Mike: For link checking locally, run:
```
python tools/link_check.py --input docs/smoke-lists/8005554321-smoke-list.md \
  --parallel 6 --timeout 10s --output reports/linkcheck-8005554321.csv
```
It spits out anchors and redirects. I’ll start the runtime pass now.

Tara: Thanks. Quick checklist:
• owners: leave a comment in the smoke-list line for the page you’re taking
• small fixes (<10 lines) — please target the docs-tiny-fixes branch and mark as reviewer-needed
• bigger edits — put a short PR description and request a squad reviewer
• goal: merge all tiny fixes by Thursday EOD so we can smoke again before Friday deploy :calendar:

Olivia: noted. also adding a unit test for the CLI snippet render in docs-ci so it fails fast next time.

Chris: I found a stale anchor in /getting-started/cli -> adding suggested redirect in a PR. pinging @Mike for a quick look.

Jordan: PRs incoming: image-rehost/runtime, image-rehost/getting-started, alttext-fixes. will add checklist items in each PR description.

Mike: Reviewed the first runtime PR, tiny nit on a code fence in the example. leaving an inline comment. :thumbsup:

Tara: Awesome. If anyone can spare an extra pair of eyes for reviews, please react to the PRs with :eyes: — want reviews to land quickly.

docs-bot: reminder scheduled: re-run linkcheck on merged commits and post report to /internal/reports/linkcheck/8005554321 in 24 hours.

Jordan: Merged two small PRs. leaving the image rehost for one last approval.

Olivia: Updated CLI snippet and added test. CI green now.

Tara: Great work everyone — will do a final smoke after lunch. If anything blocks, drop a direct message.
